title: Lettering
hero_prompt: Wide darkened backdrop in screenprint style — a single oversized capital letter, hand-drawn with rough ink strokes, its interior filled with molten ember and ash as though the letterform is a vessel holding fire; the letter sits on black, glowing at its seams, a thin canny-edge skeleton visible beneath the flame. A figure (woman) crouches below the letter with a brush, not painting the fire but releasing it from inside the stroke. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem: a single thick-stroked capital letter (block form, hand-inked) with its interior cavity filled with a single burst of light or flame — stark black outer shell, luminous void within. Designed to survive at 24px: no fine linework, no serifs, no text or numerals — purely the letter-as-vessel emblem.
